title: Everytime there is an update out Keyboard Manager shortcuts I have made stop working.

status.label: Clarify when the shortcut stops during updates
status.detail: The report says Left Win+A to Left Win+Y stops working when an update is released and works after applying it, but does not distinguish update availability from installation or restart.

judgment.rationale: The reporter lists PowerToys 0.98.1, a per-machine installation running non-elevated, and one mapping: Left Win+A to Left Win+Y. The shortcut reportedly stops when an update is released and works again after applying the update, but the report does not say whether failure begins when an update is announced, downloaded, staged, or being installed. No comments, assignees, or current-build reproduction are present.
evidence: The issue lists PowerToys 0.98.1, Windows 11 build 22631.0, a per-machine installation, and non-elevated execution.
The only listed shortcut is Left Win+A to Left Win+Y.
The reporter says the shortcut stops working when an update is released and resumes after applying it.
The report has no comments or assignees.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask which update phase triggers the failure and whether the same sequence persists on current stable before investigating update/module lifecycle behavior.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue does not isolate whether the shortcut stops when an update becomes available or only during update application/restart. Without that phase, no specific Keyboard Manager or update-lifecycle code path is established.

issue_context.summary: A single Left Win+A-to-Left Win+Y shortcut reportedly stops working around PowerToys updates and returns after the update is applied.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.98.1, Windows 11 build 22631.0, and a non-elevated per-machine installation.
The only listed mapping is Left Win+A to Left Win+Y.
The reporter says the mapping stops working when an update is released and works after applying it.
No exact update phase, reproduction steps, comments, or current-build retest are supplied.
inferences: The failure may relate to module/service lifecycle during update availability or installation, but the report does not identify which phase is involved.
issue_context.analysis: The immediate discriminator is whether the failure begins before download, while an update is staged, or only during application/restart. Ask only for that timing and a current-build result before assigning the issue to Keyboard Manager's input path or updater lifecycle.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and labels; there are no comments, linked fixes, or assignees.

information_gaps.information: Whether the shortcut fails as soon as an update is available or only during download, staging, installation, or restart, and whether it persists on current stable
information_gaps.why_needed: The update phase determines whether the failure belongs to Keyboard Manager runtime or the updater's module lifecycle.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On current stable, observe the same mapping before download, after download/staging, and after applying the update; report the first phase when it stops working.

actions.label: Identify when the shortcut stops during an update

comment.body: The report lists one mapping, Left Win+A to Left Win+Y, and says it stops when an update is released but works again after applying it. Could you confirm whether it first stops when an update becomes available, after it is downloaded/staged, or only while the update is being applied/restarting? If possible, please also say whether the same behavior occurs on current stable.
